translationRepairs: 鄆州 is Yunzhou; the existing Yanzhou incorrectly represents a different prefecture name.
On guiyou he reached Yan prefecture.
On guiyou he reached Yun prefecture.
The literal translation likewise confuses 鄆州 with Yan Prefecture and should read Yun Prefecture.
On jimao, as dawn was late in coming, the vanguard reached Bian city; Siyuan had his men seize prisoners and assault the Fengqiu gate, and Liang Kaifeng prefect Wang Zan asked to surrender the city.
On jimao near dawn, the vanguard reached Bian city; Siyuan had his men seize prisoners and assault the Fengqiu gate, and Liang Kaifeng prefect Wang Zan asked to surrender the city.
遲明 denotes the time around daybreak, not an anomalous delay in dawn's arrival.

He demoted Zheng Jue to Lai registrar, Xiao Qing to Deng registrar, Liu Yue to Jun vice-marshal, Ren Zan to Fang vice-marshal, Yao Yi to Fu vice-marshal, Feng Qiao to Tang vice-marshal, Li Yi to Huai vice-marshal, Dou Mengzheng to Yi vice-marshal, Liu Guangsu to Mi registrar, Lu Chong to An registrar, and Wang Quan to Sui registrar, all supernumerary with acting full rank.

He demoted Zheng Jue to Lai prefecture registrar, Xiao Qing to Deng prefecture registrar, Liu Yue to Jun prefecture vice-marshal, Ren Zan to Fang prefecture vice-marshal, Yao Yi to Fu prefecture vice-marshal, Feng Qiao to Tang prefecture vice-marshal, Li Yi to Huai prefecture vice-marshal, Dou Mengzheng to Yi prefecture vice-marshal, Liu Guangsu to Mi prefecture registrar, Lu Chong to An prefecture registrar, and Wang Quan to Sui prefecture registrar, all supernumerary with acting full rank.
Each office is attached to a named zhou; retaining 'prefecture' makes the list intelligible in English.
On yiwei Dou Lu Ge was told to run the upper Personnel board and Li Detiu the eastern and western boards.
On yiwei Dou Luge was told to run the upper Personnel board and Li Dexiu the eastern and western boards.
The proposal correctly repairs both names but mistypes 德休 as Dehui; standard pinyin is Dexiu.
On bingshen Duan Ning of Huazhou kept his acting post and took the imperial surname with the name Shaocheng.
On bingshen Duan Ning of Huazhou kept his acting post and took the imperial surname with the name Shaoqin.
The bestowed name is 紹欽, Shaoqin; Shaocheng has no support in the Chinese text.
That day Zhao Yan, Zhang Xiyi, the Zhang Hanjie brothers, Zhu Gui, Jing Xiang, Li Zhen, and the Khitan Sala Aba and their families were beheaded below Bian bridge.
That day Zhao Yan, Zhang Xiyi, Zhang Hanjie, Zhang Hanlun, Zhang Hanrong, Zhu Gui, Jing Xiang, Li Zhen, and the Khitan Sala Aba and their families were beheaded below Bian bridge.
The source explicitly lists Zhang Hanjie, Zhang Hanlun, and Zhang Hanrong as three named people.
Qiu had once been a horse officer; in Tianyou 13, when Cunxu faced Liu Yan at Shen, he took seven hundred horse to Liang—now he came to plead guilt.
Qiu had once been a horse officer; in Tianyou 13, when Cunxu faced Liu Xun at Shen, he took seven hundred horse to Liang—now he came to plead guilt.
The named opponent is Liu Xun, 劉鄩; 'Liu Yan' is a mistranscription of the given name.
Li Shaocheng, acting Huazhou commissioner, became Yanzhou commissioner.
Li Shaoqin, acting Huazhou commissioner, became Yanzhou commissioner.
李紹欽 is Li Shaoqin; the existing Shaocheng is inconsistent with the attested bestowed name.
Li Jiyao of Anyi came to court to await judgment and was pardoned.
Li Jitao of Anyi came to court to await judgment and was pardoned.
The commissioner's name is 李繼韜, Li Jitao; Jiyao incorrectly represents the final character.

Song became Guide, Bian Kaifeng Xuanwu again, Hua Ganhua to Zhenguo, Xu Kuangguo to Zhongwu, Hua Xuanyi to Yicheng, Shaan Zhenguo to Baoyi, Yao Jingsheng to Shunyi, Lu Kuangyi to Anyi, Lang Wushun to Wuzhen, Yan to Zhangwu, Deng to Weisheng, Jin to Jianxiong, and An to Anyuan.

The Xuanwu Army at Songzhou was renamed the Guide Army; Kaifeng Prefecture at Bianzhou again became the Xuanwu Army; the Ganhua Army at Huazhou became the Zhenguo Army; the Kuangguo Army at Xuzhou again became the Zhongwu Army; the Xuanyi Army at Huazhou again became the Yicheng Army; the Zhenguo Army at Shanzhou again became the Baoyi Army; the Jingsheng Army at Yaozhou again became the Shunyi Army; the Kuangyi Army at Luzhou again became the Anyi Army; the Wushun Army at Langzhou again became the Wuzhen Army; Yanzhou became the Zhangwu Army, Dengzhou the Weisheng Army, Jinzhou the Jianxiong Army, and Anzhou the Anyuan Army.
The proposed expansion is right, but explicitly naming each military command as an Army preserves 軍 and makes the renamings clear.
On xinsi Li Jiyao of Anyi was demoted to Deng long-history, then beheaded at the Tianjin Bridge for plotting revolt again.
On xinsi Li Jitao of Anyi was demoted to Dengzhou long-history, then beheaded at the Tianjin Bridge for plotting revolt again.
李繼韜 is Li Jitao and 登州 is Dengzhou; both corrections directly follow the Chinese.
On jisi Palace Attendant Cui Juyi was made Vice Minister of Punishments and charged as reviser of the History Office with direction of its affairs.
On jisi Palace Attendant Cui Jujian was made Vice Minister of Punishments and charged as reviser of the History Office with direction of its affairs.
The official is 崔居儉, Cui Jujian; the existing Juyi omits the final character and misreads the name.
